commit_message:
[Codegen][CPU] Add x86 AVX-512 VNNI vpdpbusd MMA intrinsic.

Adds `vpdpbusd` — the AVX-512-VNNI byte dot-product — as a data-tiled
MMA intrinsic. It is the first asymmetric MMA: the first byte source
is unsigned, the second is signed, so the natural and swapped
orientations need different arg-routing at the call site (unlike the
LHS/RHS-symmetric FMA / dpbf16ps / vpdpwssd / pmaddw already
supported).

Two new enum values, `MMA_X86_AVX512VNNI_1x16x4_I32_UI8_I8` and its
M↔N-swapped sibling `MMA_X86_AVX512VNNI_16x1x4_I32_I8_UI8`, both
lower to `llvm.x86.avx512.vpdpbusd.512`. The swapped lowering flips
its (lhs, rhs) call args so the unsigned operand still lands in the
first slot.

Signedness handling — per IREE convention, vector tile types in IR are
signless, with the signed/unsigned distinction carried on the
encoding's `element_types`. `getABCElementTypes(intrinsic)` now
returns `ui8` where applicable, used by the cost model and validator
for matching against an encoding's `element_types`;
`getUndistributedTileTypes` strips the signedness when constructing
tile types. The validator and cost-model `getIntrinsicInfo` bypass
`getUndistributedTileTypes` and read shape + types straight from the
intrinsic via `getRowMajorTilesMNKShape` and `getABCElementTypes`,
which become public for that reason.

The prerequisite "distinct LHS/RHS types" PR added the
`e2e_matmul_cpu_dt_inner_tiled_ui8_i8_i32` test on the `generic`
variant only; this commit adds the `avx512vnni` variant that
actually selects the new intrinsic.

Progress towards #24323.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
